description: An abstract controller class that provides common functionality for serving files, including response creation, setting headers, and managing file responses within the OrangeHRM system framework.

classes.name: AbstractFileController
classes.description: An abstract class extending AbstractController, providing methods to handle file responses, set appropriate headers, and prepare files for download within the OrangeHRM framework.

methods.name: getNewFileResponse
methods.description: Creates and returns a new BinaryFileResponse object for the given file path.

methods.name: getFileResponse
methods.description: Returns a cached BinaryFileResponse or creates a new one if not already set, for the specified file.

methods.name: makeAttachmentDisposition
methods.description: Constructs and returns the Content-Disposition header value to prompt file download with proper filename encoding.

methods.name: setCommonHeadersToResponse
methods.description: Configures standard headers on the response object for file download, including content type, length, disposition, caching, and encoding.
